body:
# Pixelmon::Sleek Version

### Explore, battle, and catch Pokémon in a polished Minecraft adventure.

Pixelmon::Sleek Version is a carefully curated modpack designed to enhance the Pixelmon experience with a selection of complementary mods. The goal is to provide an immersive adventure while preserving Pixelmon as the heart of the pack.

### Features
- ✨ Carefully selected supporting mods
- 🗺️ Expanded exploration
- 🎒 Quality-of-life improvements
- ⚙️ Balanced and polished configuration

Whether you enjoy collecting Pokémon, building your base, exploring new landscapes, or taking on challenging battles, Pixelmon::Sleek Version offers a refined experience with everything working together seamlessly.
